onion.soilType: Well-drained sandy loam to loam soil
onion.climate: Cool and dry climate during bulb formation
onion.waterRequirement: Moderate; requires regular irrigation but does not tolerate waterlogging

wheat.soilType: Well-drained loam or clay loam soil
wheat.climate: Cool growing season with dry and warm conditions during grain maturity
wheat.waterRequirement: Moderate; irrigation is important during critical growth stages

rice.soilType: Clayey or clay loam soil with good water-holding capacity
rice.waterRequirement: High; requires abundant water, especially during establishment and vegetative growth

cotton.soilType: Deep black soil or well-drained loamy soil
cotton.climate: Warm climate with a long frost-free period
cotton.waterRequirement: Moderate; sensitive to excessive moisture and waterlogging

tomato.soilType: Well-drained fertile sandy loam or loam soil
tomato.waterRequirement: Moderate to high; requires consistent moisture without waterlogging

soybean.soilType: Well-drained loam to clay loam soil
soybean.climate: Warm growing season with adequate rainfall
soybean.waterRequirement: Moderate; sensitive to both drought and waterlogging

maize.soilType: Well-drained fertile loam or sandy loam soil
maize.waterRequirement: Moderate to high, particularly during flowering and grain filling

potato.waterRequirement: Moderate; needs consistent moisture but is sensitive to waterlogging

chickpea.soilType: Well-drained loam to sandy loam soil
chickpea.waterRequirement: Low to moderate; excessive moisture can damage the crop

sugarcane.soilType: Deep fertile loam or clay loam with good drainage
sugarcane.climate: Warm and humid climate with a long growing season
sugarcane.waterRequirement: High; requires regular and adequate irrigation
